# snipeit_accessory_checkout (Resource)

Checks one unit of an accessory out to a user. Creating the resource performs the checkout, destroying it checks the unit back in. All attributes force replacement. Snipe-IT v8 only supports users as accessory checkout targets via the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Check one unit of an accessory out to a user; destroy checks it back in.
resource "snipeit_accessory_checkout" "keyboard_to_alice" {
  accessory_id = snipeit_accessory.mx_keys.id
  user_id      = 42
  note         = "new hire kit"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `accessory_id` (Number) Id of the accessory to check out.
- `user_id` (Number) Id of the user receiving the accessory.

### Optional

- `note` (String) Note recorded with the checkout.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Id of the checkout (pivot) row, used for checkin.
